d.ko:
Psychopomp is BACK.
The catacombs stretch down farther than ever before. Your entire life has been a lie. Delve into the depths, and discover the horrors that lie below. More realms, more modes, more secrets. An ancient voice calls to you from the center of the earth. Will you answer it?

rv.t: Real world tip: 100%ing the game doesn't unlock all the secrets. TO find out how the world really works go to your local government building and find it's heart.
You know the horror game is going to be good when 90% of its fanbase is russian
I hate to write negative reviews, and I really tried to like this game, but I just can't. Gameplay-wise, it is really bare bones, not much interaction with characters and the environment. …
神一般的氛围美工，还有人物恰到好处的设定，喜欢这份魔幻的感觉。希望psychopomp2早日上线，快端上来罢！
究竟是这泵还是真实世界使她精神分裂，我们不得而知 带有后启示录风格的电波系独立游戏。过高的灵视带来了癫狂的底色，坦克模式操作也对渲染氛围起了很好的作用（即恐游经典设计理念之：玩家操作的不灵便性会加深恐怖感。）。 …
